I graded submission s2 for quiz 0001 and wrote the grades to `grades/0001-s2.json`. Riley got three items correct, two partial and one wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | correct | The model outputs a request; the program runs the tool. |
| q3 | wrong (M6) | Chose "left to run longer, it will eventually fix the bug". |
| q4 | partial (M4) | The count of 4 is right, but the reasoning says the model "runs" each tool itself. |
| q5 | correct | Gave both parts: the result goes back as the next input, so the model can decide its next step. |
| q6 | partial | Said "by the name", but the model uses the whole tool description. |

**What Riley has down:** the loop structure (q1, q2) and how results feed back to the model (q5).

**The idea to work on:** a stuck agent doesn't eventually succeed, because step 41 sees the same input as step 40. It needs a stopping condition (q3).

**Next step:** write two stopping conditions for the makerspace assistant's loop, and say what each should do when it triggers.

The `grade-reviewer` agent ran two passes. I fixed two findings: the summary now names one idea, and q4 points back to q2 instead of repeating it. I declined two findings about the "Try first:" questions in q4 and q6, because the grade skill requires the full answer right after that question. The review record is `review-records/0001-s2-grade.md`.

I also added learning record `learning-records/0003-stuck-agent-needs-a-stop.md` and updated `NOTES.md`.
